messages.author: 59e139ba37e5be2e
messages.subject: Github packages in shiny build
parts:
Hi all,

Is it possible to use development packages hosted on GitHub for a shiny app? I'm interested in using https://github.com/rstats-db/RPostgres but the build failed.

Thank you,

Taylor

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Github packages in shiny build
parts:
Yes, you should definitely be able to use packages from Github.  The shinyapps package should detect the version of the package you have installed and include that in the manifest it sends to shinyapps.io.

-Tareef
On Sat, May 16, 2015 at 8:59 PM, Taylor White <taylorge...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi all,

Is it possible to use development packages hosted on GitHub for a shiny app? I'm interested in using https://github.com/rstats-db/RPostgres but the build failed.

Thank you,

Taylor
